Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: transparent RimWorld pawn HEAD only. Image 1 is the edit target, the already approved flat stylized Vertin v13 head. Image 2 is the original game portrait, used ONLY to identify the small light freckles across the upper bridge of her nose and immediately adjacent upper cheeks. Make a minimal local addition of these identity freckles to Image 1. Do not imitate Image 2's facial proportions, shading, hat angle, realism, eye occlusion or expression. Preserve Image 1's exact head pose, silhouette, placement, crop, hair and hat shapes, thick outer outline, thin internal marks, grey-green eyes and their dimensions/spacing, relaxed brows, nose, lips and chin. Preserve the current pale ivory face/ear color exactly as closely as possible; this is NOT a palette revision. Freckles should be a sparse irregular cluster of tiny separated muted light warm-brown dots, much softer than the dark outline. Express a few representative spots only, never texture noise, dense pores, blush, acne, large moles, scar lines or a dark horizontal stripe. They must remain delicate in the final approximately 40-pixel-wide face. Do not add freckles to forehead, chin, ears, hair or hat. Single head, same orientation and whole framing as Image 1; keep real transparent background and all alpha edges. No text or comparison layout.

Slightly irregular spacing and size, not mirrored perfectly. At this source size spots are roughly 5-8 pixels wide, designed to downsample to around one soft native pixel.
